# A RenderCV file (rendercv.com). Your email and phone are added when the PDF is made.
cv:
  name: Jordan Ellery
  headline: Computer Science graduate building production AI tooling
  location: London
  custom_connections:
    - fontawesome_icon: link
      placeholder: jordan-ellery.example
      url: https://jordan-ellery.example
    - fontawesome_icon: link
      placeholder: code.jordan-ellery.example
      url: https://code.jordan-ellery.example
  sections:
    Summary:
      - 'Computer Science graduate building production AI tooling: a FastAPI PII-detection gateway for LLM prompts, and a live TypeScript and Postgres platform with real users.'
    Experience:
      - company: International Digital Standards Union
        position: AI Intern
        start_date: 2026-02
        end_date: 2026-08
        location: Geneva
        highlights:
          - Built a FastAPI API gateway that scans prompts for personal data (regex and Presidio) before they reach third-party LLMs.
          - Wrote prompt templates and evaluation notes for the gateway's redaction rules with the security team.
      - company: Fieldmark
        position: Founder and Developer
        start_date: 2024-09
        end_date: present
        location: London
        highlights:
          - Built and run a scouting platform for grassroots basketball clubs in Europe on Next.js, Supabase / Postgres and Stripe, with real users.
          - Added a LangGraph agent in Python that drafts weekly scouting summaries from coach notes for review.
    Projects:
      - company: LangChain community integrations
        position: Open-source contributor
        start_date: 2025-03
        end_date: 2025-06
        highlights:
          - Added structured-output retries with schema validation to a LangChain community model integration in Python.
    Education:
      - institution: University of Westmoor
        area: Computer Science
        degree: BSc
        start_date: 2023-09
        end_date: 2026-06
    Skills:
      - Python · FastAPI · LangGraph · PostgreSQL · LLM guardrails · Presidio
